B_to_Xs_gamma.accuracy: NLO QCD matching/evolution/numerator; original legacy EM, power corrections and semileptonic normalization; real top-only unprimed charged scalars. Not NNLO or 2026 precision.

SM_decay_card.EW_scheme: frozen D2 on-shell MW/MZ; g2=2mW/v, cw=mW/mZ, g1=g2*tan(thetaW)
SM_decay_card.EW_source: module3/example.json SHA-bound snapshot; 2021 reference Appendix C; v from frozen scalar normalization
SM_decay_card.kinematic_scheme: t pole from cross section; b approximate two-loop pole; light/c reference MS masses used as partonic thresholds
SM_decay_card.lepton_scheme: frozen D2 charged-lepton pole snapshot; no QED running
SM_decay_card.neutrino_scheme: exact massless tree-level native Fv; inclusive three unitary-rotated neutrinos, both helicities; loop-induced mass effects uncomputed
SM_decay_card.scheme_sensitivity: also report same kinematics with unevolved reference Yukawa masses; diagnostic, not theory uncertainty
SM_decay_card.yukawa_scheme: MSbar one-loop QCD evolution to mother mass; continuous matching at mb=4.183 and mt_pole=172.4; no finite threshold terms

accuracy: Implemented signed dipole subset; coherent neutral tree subset; D4 on-shell tree two-body decay dictionary; no complete flavor prediction

limitations: Wgamma BLOCKED and excluded; Zgamma, WZ, other EW two-loop and non-dipole photon/Z penguins, boxes and interference missing.
Scalar one-loop external-invariant/massless-neutrino approximation; exact one-loop UNKNOWN. Nominal unmatched Module4 mass/Yukawa card, including illustrative perturbative light-quark loops.
Tree mu3e and tau3l subsets retain both contractions, exact final masses, propagators and identical-particle phase space; missing loops can interfere.
Universality includes scalar F terms only, not D/mixed contributions; no precision-data test.
Partial subset rates are neither lower nor upper bounds on full model rates; omitted amplitudes may interfere destructively.
D10 proof covers only frozen reconstructed tree potentials, unchanged by Yukawa variations. Quantum vacuum and RG unknown; three other D10 representatives UNKNOWN.
NuFIT6.1 secondary summary coordinates only; no joint likelihood, ordering preference, nuisance prior or cosmological mass filter.
D4 analytic dictionary previously validated against native SARAH is applied here; no fresh D10 SARAH run. On-shell tree two-body BRs only; no off-shell or finite-width/NLO correction.
No exact D10 production/PDF/cards; both collider energies and sigma times BR remain null. Hard Type-II production has no general lepton-Yukawa dependence.
Bsgamma is source-verified legacy NLO QCD with original EM/power/normalization scheme; independent physical accuracy and 2026 global filter NOT_CERTIFIED.
HiggsTools collider-search coverage incomplete; no mass exclusion, detector sensitivity or global model acceptance. Numerical tolerances are not theory uncertainties.
novelty_verdict: NOT_ESTABLISHED: flavor texture can retain the cascade, not a demonstrated unavoidable flavor-collider restriction; no paper headline yet
objective: Discrete minimum of max(BR_implemented(mu e gamma)/1.5e-13, BR_tree(mu3e)/1e-12) over exactly 28 specified designs/group; no statistical interpretation. Three minimum-norm texture constructions impose D_e_mu=D_mu_e=0 with coefficient norm <0.01.
